questions.question: What do you wish people spoke about more honestly when they talk about sex?
What last made you feel desire before anything physical happened?
Finish the sentence: I wish I did not have to ask for...
Which desire, or lack of desire, have you judged in yourself?
What would you do differently in a past sexual experience if honesty had felt easier?
What turns you off that you have been tempted to tolerate anyway?
What did you try because you thought you should like it?
Think of deeply satisfying sex. What made it feel good beyond technique?
Besides pleasure, what need have you asked sex to meet?
Where does shame still get to make decisions in your sex life?
What have you learned to enjoy on your own terms?
Which intimate moment would you revisit for the feeling, not the performance?
How do you treat yourself as a sexual partner?
What would you ask for if rejection did not feel like a verdict on you?
What are you craving that sex alone cannot provide?
